LanguageData.CrystalTech.label: crystal tech
LanguageData.CrystalTech.description: Learn to manufacture advanced transparent building materials with light transmission, fireproofing, airtight sealing, and self-cleaning properties.
LanguageData.CrystalAdvanced.label: crystal advanced
LanguageData.CrystalAdvanced.description: Integrate solar crystal film and power circuitry into trans-crystal structures, enabling self-powering walls, doors, and lamps with cloaked creature detection.
LanguageData.CrystalReinforced.label: crystal reinforcement
LanguageData.CrystalReinforced.description: Learn to reinforce crystal structures with advanced binding techniques, creating nearly indestructible transparent walls and fortifications.
